figure_alt: Scatterplot comparing August through October 2025 with the same months in 2026. Each dot represents a signifier. The horizontal axis shows the absolute composition component and the vertical axis shows the absolute within-repeat component, both in percentage points. Most dots lie below the dashed line of equal magnitude, where the composition component is larger.
prompt: For widely observed signifiers, how much of the change over calendar time reflects changing participant composition versus changes within repeat participants?
title: Changing answers and changing participants
